note: Indonesia: visit visa exemption (BVK) for 30 days, not extendable, for the ten ASEAN states and, by Permenimipas No. 10 of 2026 (in force 9 July 2026), Suriname, Colombia, Hong Kong, Türkiye, Brazil, Peru, Macao, Kazakhstan and Belarus. The Directorate General of Immigration's visa-on-arrival list (also obtainable online in advance as an e-VOA; 30 days, extendable once) is read from Wikipedia's copy of it, which agrees with the 2026 regulation's BVK list. Nationals of Bangladesh, Cameroon, Guinea, Iran and Yemen need a guarantor in Indonesia to apply, and those of Afghanistan, Israel, Liberia, Nigeria, North Korea and Somalia a 'calling visa' approved in Jakarta (both taken as visas); everyone else applies for an e-Visa online. The e-Visa portal refuses this client (202 challenge).

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Indonesia: visa exemption, visa on arrival, guarantor and calling visas
sources.said: Citizens of the following countries may enter Indonesia without a visa, for a maximum stay of 30 days with the biggest caveat being that one may not extend his/her stay at all past 30 days, and the following visitors get a 30 day e-VOA if they may need one extension: All ASEAN member states Belarus Brazil Colombia Hong Kong Kazakhstan Macau Peru Suriname Turkey ... Citizens of the following countries may apply for a visa on arrival. This visa costs Rp 500,000, and is valid for a maximum stay of 30 days. ... All ASEAN member states All European Union member states Albania Andorra Argentina Armenia Australia Azerbaijan Bahrain Belarus Bosnia and Herzegovina Brazil Canada Chile China Colombia Ecuador Egypt Guatemala Hong Kong Iceland India Japan Jordan Kazakhstan Kenya Kuwait Liechtenstein Maldives Mauritius Mexico Monaco Mongolia Morocco Mozambique New Zealand Norway Oman Palestine Papua New Guinea Peru Qatar Russia Rwanda Saudi Arabia Serbia Seychelles South Africa South Korea Suriname Switzerland Taiwan Tanzania Tunisia Turkey Ukraine United Arab Emirates United Kingdom United States Uzbekistan Vatican City Venezuela ... Citizens of the following countries are ineligible to apply independently and must secure an Indonesian guarantor to apply on their behalf. Bangladesh Cameroon Guinea Iran Yemen ...
